name: mllewellynjones-skills
description: Claude skills for structured knowledge work

plugins.name: cv-review
plugins.description: Structured CV critique: nine weighted scoring criteria, a 30-second recruiter test, red-flag scanning with remedies, jurisdiction norms, and bullet-by-bullet verdicts with suggested rewrites.

plugins.name: framing-review
plugins.description: Structure, framing, and storyline review for slide decks and documents — pressure-tests whether an artefact actually argues its case to its audience, with action titles, a harsh coverage check, and create/review workflows for decks and documents.

plugins.name: deep-reading
plugins.description: A demanding post-reading debrief for non-fiction — free recall with the book closed, gap-finding, stress-tested connections, falsification, and a comparable three-dimension grade. Chapter-by-chapter for books with a whole-book synthesis, or single sessions for articles and papers.

plugins.name: skills-sync
plugins.description: Maintenance skill for this repo: diffs locally installed skill copies against the published versions, runs the privacy pass, pushes approved changes with version bumps, and reports what still needs a manual claude.ai re-upload.
